Private witnesses force k>=r; union-size capacity forces q>=ceil(r(k-1)/(r-1)). The reserved-private-point construction fills capacities for every q at/above the bound. Full S5 relations arise by independently partitioning b residual points, exactly B_b^r; multivariate inclusion-exclusion counts all labeled local configurations. At sharp carrier the excess degree delta=rb-q ranges 0..r-2, giving r=3 unique double-omission case and both explicit factorial formulas. Independent exhaustive small r,s enumeration and Bell checks passed. No generalization to repeated data values.
